content.text:
The robot reached the green panel at the end of the corridor and is now resting, with its motors off.

It is about 0.2 m from the panel, facing it. The panel fills the camera view, and both side sonars read about 0.45 m.

The route was not a straight corridor. It walked about 4.6 m forward, then turned left and walked about 3.3 m along the new passage, stepping around obstacles. It sidestepped several times where the wall ahead blocked the walk, and it turned left again near the end to face the panel.
